🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-30 23:00 → 2026-10-31 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **A spec turned into a reviewed pull request** — trust-root authority and authenticated execution moved from draft text into runnable code and test cases. [tg:tawg:5970]

> **Cold-run review found real gaps** — an independent checker pass on the pinned commit gave the review concrete fixes to make. [PR #1 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/wyriwe-signing/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5722562923)

> **Both gaps closed in the same window** — the fixes landed at a4b7a4cb, letting the review end on verified code. [tg:tawg:5972]

> **On-chain verification went independent** — an end-to-end read-back ran with an automated agent and saved reports behind it. [tg:tawg:5968]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### wyriwe-signing

_The signing spec moved from draft text into a reviewed pull request with fixes verified against a pinned commit._

- Baby Blue Viper **opened** PR #1 for the signing spec, covering trust-root authority in §6, authenticated execution in §9 step 7, plus test cases 4c and 9a, which turns the spec into something reviewers can actually run. [tg:tawg:5970]
- Merlini **cold-ran** the checker against the pinned commit and reviewed draft 3, testing the work independently and surfacing the two gaps that mattered, which let the fixes land before the spec hardened further. [PR #1 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/wyriwe-signing/pull/1#pullrequestreview-5722562923)
- Baby Blue Viper **closed** both flagged gaps at a4b7a4cb in the examples directory, so the review ended with verified code rather than a list of open questions. [tg:tawg:5972]

### on-chain verification

_Verification shifted from a one-off read to a repeatable automated check._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **completed** the independent on-chain read-back and got a local AI agent running automated verification with saved reports, giving the group a repeatable way to confirm on-chain results instead of re-checking by hand. [tg:tawg:5968]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Fold the automated verification and saved-report loop into the signing test cases so authenticated execution keeps a standing check.
- Apply the same independent cold-run treatment to the next spec section before it reaches review.
- See whether the trust-root authority section can be exercised against fresh test results in the same way.

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Run the checker against the next pinned commit and post the outcome in the PR thread.
- Look through the updated examples at a4b7a4cb for pieces worth promoting into the spec text.
- Share the saved verification reports so other members can reproduce the runs.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** a cold-run review and a same-window fix turned a draft spec into verified code in one clean loop.
>
> Keep passing drafts around like a relay baton — they only speed up once someone actually runs with them 🏃
